arabic text: AB KON BACHAAEGA MERI BEHNO KI CHAADAR
english translation text: My lion-like brother was killed beside the river. Who will now protect my sisters' chadars?

arabic text: SHEH KEHTE THE ABBAS KE HAATHO’N KO UTHAAKAR
english translation text: The King said this while lifting Abbas's severed hands.

arabic text: AY BHAAYI TERE GHAM MEI’N KAMAR TOOTH GAYI HAI\nMEI’N KAISE BATAO’N TUJHE HALAT JO MERI HAI\nIK HAATH HAI SEENE PE TO EK HAATH KAMAR PER
english translation text: O brother, grief for you has broken my back.\nHow can I explain my condition to you?\nOne hand is upon my chest, and one upon my back.

arabic text: BHAYA MERI ZAINAB KO BARI AAS THI TUM SE\nAAYI THE WATAN CHOR KE WHO TERE SAHAARE\nKIS TARA JIYENGI WHO TERE MARNE KA SUNKAR
english translation text: Brother, my Zainab placed such hope in you.\nShe left her homeland relying upon your support.\nHow will she live when she hears of your death?

arabic text: GHURBAT PE MERE HAAL PE ROTI HAI KHUDAAI\nJAANE SE TERE DASHT MEI’N HAM LUT GAYE BHAAI\nABBAS TERE DAM SE THA AABAAD MERA GHAR
english translation text: All creation weeps over my loneliness and condition.\nWith your departure, we were plundered in this desert, brother.\nAbbas, my home flourished only through you.

arabic text: EK TEER TERI AANKH MEIN PAIWAST HAI BHAAYI\nBAZOO KI TARHA SE TERE PAO’N BHI JUDA HAI\nHAI KOON RAWA’N GURZ SE ZAKHMI HAI TERA SAR
english translation text: An arrow is lodged in your eye, brother.\nLike your arms, even your feet have been severed.\nBlood flows, and your head is wounded by the mace.

arabic text: IK KOOZA LIYE HAATH MEIN BAITHI HAI SAKINA\nPAANI TO USE DEDO UTHO GHAR CHALO BHAYA\nMARJAENGI YEH BHAI TERI LAASH UTHA KAR
english translation text: Sakina sits holding a small cup.\nRise, give her water and come home, brother.\nShe will die while lifting your body.

arabic text: YEH SOCH KE KIS TARHA RUKEI’N AANKH SE AANSU\nTHA KAUN SAHARA TERE JAB KAT GAYE BAAZO\nTU CHEHRE KE BAL ZEEN SE AAYA HAI ZAMEE’N PER
english translation text: How can tears stop when I think\nthat when your arms were severed, no support remained?\nYou fell face-first from the saddle onto the earth.

arabic text: BHAI SE JUDAAI KA WHO MANZAR LIKHOON KAISE\nAKBAR NE SAHARA DIYA LAASHA SE GARI KE\nZEESHAN O KARIM UTHE SHAHE WALA YEH KEHKAR
english translation text: O Zeeshan and Karim, how can I write the scene of separation from a brother?\nAkbar supported him as he rose from the body,\nwhile the exalted King said these words.
